faq_heading: Homes near William F. Davidson Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the William F. Davidson Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the William F. Davidson Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names William F. Davidson Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near William F. Davidson Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 81 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,188,500, townhomes $722,500, condos $520,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near William F. Davidson Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of William F. Davidson Elementary the median was 24 days on the market, closing at 96.8% of the list price, with 9% of sales above the list price for the 81 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to William F. Davidson Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Johnston Heights Secondary (0.4 km west), Mountainview Montessori (0.7 km south-west) and Harold Bishop Elementary (0.9 km north).

William F. Davidson Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 15550 99a Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name William F. Davidson Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the William F. Davidson Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names William F. Davidson Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of William F. Davidson Elementary sold for

Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 81 homes sold within 1 km of William F. Davidson Elementary: 32 houses, 24 townhomes and 25 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,188,500.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of William F. Davidson Elementary

23 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of William F. Davidson Elementary in a straight line (16 elementary, 5 secondary, 2 other; 4 independent). The closest is Johnston Heights Secondary, 0.4 km away, and the farthest on this list is Frost Road Elementary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Mountainview Montessori (0.7 km); the nearest independent school is St Matthew's Elementary (2.4 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is North Surrey Secondary (1.1 km). Other elementary schools close by: Mountainview Montessori (0.7 km south-west), Harold Bishop Elementary (0.9 km north), Berkshire Park Elementary (1.2 km south), Bonaccord Elementary (1.2 km west), Serpentine Heights Elementary (1.6 km south-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Mountainview Montessori, 0.7 km south-west of William F. Davidson Elementary.
